name: MiniScale
desc: Puts the device on your tailnet (unofficial Tailscale client)
facts: Keeps the tailnet login on the card only encrypted, with a key in the device's own flash.
system: Adds a boot script (.tmp_update/startup/miniscale.sh) that starts Tailscale at boot while it is switched on, and a device key in the internal flash (/appconfigs/minideck.key).
